headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere, 'Heroes' and 'Nashville' Actor, Dies at 36
headlines.description: Police are investigating the sudden death of Hayden Panettiere, star of TV and film, after being found unresponsive at her South Carolina home. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
headlines.description: The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Kushner meets with Netanyahu after rare Hamas talks over stalled Gaza plan
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s son-in-law and envoy Jared Kushner met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday after rare talks with the leader of Hamas, in a new push to revive the peace plan for Gaza that Israel has rejected.

headlines.title: Jury in Tupac Murder Trial Set to Hear Opening Statements
headlines.description: Opening statements are set to begin Monday in the Tupac Shakur murder case, as a now 63-year-old man is tried for the 1996 killing of the rap icon. Duane “Keefe D” Davis, who authorities say was the “shot caller” in the murder, is now finally set to stand trial for one of the biggest murder mysteries as lawyers look to lay out what really happened the night Tupac was fatally shot. NBC’s Dana Griffin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Video Shows Woman Landing Perfectly in Firetruck Rescue Basket
headlines.description: Dramatic video shows an apartment fire in Berlin where a woman hanging from a window on the 11th floor is seen jumping two floors down and landing perfectly into a firetruck’s rescue basket.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: 72-year-old woman says she was hit with pepper spray while recording ICE agents in Manhattan
headlines.description: Linda Wolff, an immigrant rights supporter, filed a federal tort claim against ICE after the incident.

headlines.title: Supreme Court turns away Trump’s latest bid to block E. Jean Carroll award
headlines.description: The Supreme Court turned away for a second time President Donald Trump’s bid to overturn a jury verdict that awarded $5 million to writer E. Jean Carroll for alleged sexual abuse and defamation.

headlines.title: Actor Hayden Panettiere, known for roles in ‘Heroes’ and ‘Nashville,’ dies at 36
headlines.description: The cause and manner of death were unclear. Panettiere revealed this year that she struggled with postpartum depression and addiction, which she said led to her decision to give up custody of her daughter in 2018.
